title: bardolier move output
description: What `bardolier move` did — a project's ports never change, so this is reported by the manifest's new location, never by rewriting anything inside the directory. cli-spec.md §6 (Projects), phase 21. Additive changes only once the app ships (Phase 5+).

moved.description: False when the project was already under the target root — `move` is idempotent (§2).

bytes.description: The project's size on disk, reported in both modes; 0 for a no-op.

mode.description: `rename` on one filesystem (also reported for the no-op); `copy` when `EXDEV` forced a staged copy.
